name: 17777 · Watsontown, PA
findings: ZIP 17777 (Watsontown) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 17777 (Watsontown) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
